scope: Five supplied photographs: Worksheets 14, 15, 16 and two handwritten force-note pages (October 2026).
boundaries: Frictionless translation, ideal ropes and fixed pulleys. No friction coefficients, torque or energy methods. Notes on tension and normal forces are interpreted as forces on the chosen object. Worksheet 16 #4 is interpreted as greatest pull that still maintains contact; handwritten work is not an authoritative key.

questions.title: Two cable sensors in a moving lift
questions.transfer_task: Infer an unknown mass from two sensors; distinguish downward motion from upward acceleration.

questions.title: A ramp experiment before and after release
questions.transfer_task: Infer the incline angle from a holding-force ratio, find an actuator force for uphill acceleration, then change the force inventory at release and reason at the turning point.

questions.title: A clamp changes a ramp’s contact force
questions.transfer_task: Distinguish perpendicular force changes from parallel acceleration.

questions.title: Replacing one puller with a fixed anchor
questions.transfer_task: Use a cut through a rope to predict a sensor reading and an anchor reaction.

questions.title: A cable redirects a load
questions.transfer_task: Compare mount loads for two rope directions, rather than adding tension magnitudes.

questions.title: Inferring a hidden counterweight
questions.transfer_task: Infer mass from observed acceleration; distinguish rope tension from each weight.

questions.title: Choosing a cable angle under a tension limit
questions.transfer_task: Infer minimum angle from a cable rating and determine the force in the horizontal tie.

questions.title: Reconstructing a suspended load
questions.transfer_task: Recover total weight and compare unequal tensions from a measured single-cable reading.

questions.title: Holding a specimen against a smooth wall
questions.transfer_task: Predict how changing the applied-force angle changes both force and wall reaction.

questions.title: Correcting a steering force
questions.transfer_task: Create a specified nonzero resultant, then compare with the force needed for equilibrium.

questions.title: Reading a contact sensor during an angled pull
questions.transfer_task: Infer a pull from a normal-force reading; predict contact threshold and its mass dependence.
